review_candidates.title: Finance Manager (m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: Company & Role Overview About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. Role Overview As Finance Manager, you own the integrity of our financial records and help build the accounting backbone that enables Hilo to scale internationally. You will own the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close across multiple legal entities, Group consolidation, VAT and financial compliance, and the supervision of day-to-day accounting activities. This is a hands-on role where you will both oversee accounting processes and external providers and investigate complex accounting issues, reconciliations and transactions yourself. You will also help make Finance more scalable by using automation and AI to reduce repetitive work, strengthen controls and move towards exception-based accounting processes. You report to the VP Finance and work closely with Finance, Operations, Sales, Growth and People, as well as external accountants, tax advisors and auditors across several jurisdictions. Core Responsibilities Accounting & Financial Close Own the monthly, quarterly and annual closing process across the Group Coordinate accounting across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions, ensuring consistent practices and timely reporting Supervise the day-to-day accounting activities of a two-person team, covering revenue, COGS, inventory, payroll, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets and general ledger accounting Review journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting documentation and balance sheet accounts, ensuring outstanding items are investigated and resolved Maintain the closing calendar, responsibilities and controls, including appropriate cut-off and accounting treatment across entities Continuously improve the speed, quality and reliability of the close Act as a key Finance contact for annual audits and reviews and provide required financial information and documentation Partner closely with the FP&A team to ensure timely, accurate and consistent financial reporting and a clear understanding of financial performance Group Consolidation Own monthly Group consolidation across multiple entities and currencies Manage intercompany entries, reconciliations and eliminations Review foreign currency translation and other consolidation adjustments Maintain the Group consolidation structure and consistency between local accounting and Group reporting VAT, Tax & Compliance Coordinate VAT compliance across the countries in which the Group operates and sells its products, including supervision of VAT returns and reconciliations Ensure correct VAT treatment of D2C, B2B, ecommerce and subscription transactions Coordinate other indirect tax obligations, including GST and sales tax where applicable Support corporate income tax filings, tax provisions and other local tax requirements with external advisors Maintain the compliance calendar and ensure financial and tax obligations are completed accurately and on time Support transfer pricing, intercompany recharges and related documentation where required Systems, Data & Controls Own accounting and financial reporting processes within NetSuite and investigate system and accounting issues through to resolution Improve automation across reconciliations, consolidation, reporting and recurring accounting activities Ensure accurate financial data flows from ecommerce, logistics, payroll, banking and other operational systems into Finance Identify process weaknesses and implement practical solutions Document key Finance processes and accounting policies and ensure appropriate documentation and audit trails AI, Automation & Process Improvement Make AI and automation a core part of Finance operations, reducing manual work and enabling the team to focus on exceptions, judgement and higher-value activities Identify and automate recurring accounting, closing, reconciliation and compliance activities Design AI-enabled workflows for areas such as balance sheet reconciliations, intercompany matching, VAT reviews, transaction classification, closing controls and anomaly detection Develop an exception-based approach where systems identify transactions and balances requiring human review Use AI to investigate financial data, identify unusual transactions and accelerate root-cause analysis while maintaining human oversight Build reusable Finance workflows, agents and controls rather than relying on one-off analyses Ensure appropriate controls, documentation, data protection and human validation for AI-enabled processes Measure impact through improvements such as shorter closing timelines, fewer manual reconciliations, reduced errors and increased Finance capacity Requirements Background & Experience What You'll Bring Essential 5+ years of experience in accounting, audit (Big 4), financial controlling or a similar Finance role, ideally in an international environment Strong technical accounting knowledge and understanding of P&L, balance sheet and cash flow accounting Hands-on experience owning or coordinating monthly and annual financial closings Experience with multiple legal entities and intercompany accounting Strong understanding of financial controls and audit requirements Experience working with ERP systems and investigating transactions directly within the system Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills and confidence working with large financial datasets Excellent written and spoken English A hands-on, ownership-driven approach and the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes Interest in using AI, automation and new technologies to improve Finance processes and reduce manual work Nice to Have CPA, ACCA, ACA, Swiss Certified Expert in Accounting and Controlling or equivalent qualification Experience with NetSuite and Aleph Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation Experience in an international scale-up or fast-growing company Experience with VAT compliance across several European jurisdictions Experience with US sales tax, Australian GST or other international indirect tax regimes Experience with inventory accounting and product COGS Experience with AI, workflow automation, data analytics or other Finance automation tools What Success Looks Like In Your First 90 Days 30 days: Understand the Group structure, accounting setup, close process, key reporting and compliance requirements. 60 days: Own the monthly close, consolidation and VAT calendar, and identify key process and automation opportunities. 90 days: Own the Group close and consolidation end to end, with reconciliations and compliance under control and the first automation or AI workflow live. After 6-12 Months Closing and compliance are accurate and predictable, key reconciliations and audits run efficiently, and Finance increasingly relies on automated controls and AI-driven workflows to operate more efficiently and scale with the business. Benefits What Makes You A Great Fit At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that reliable financial information is fundamental to good decision-making and take accountability for the quality of the numbers from transaction through to consolidated reporting. Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with accuracy. You continuously improve the way Finance operates, experiment with better tools and processes, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work. Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, auditors, accountants and advisors across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for financial accuracy and compliance. Why Join Us? Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location) Ready to Move the Needle? If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

You’ll be supporting elite founders and visionary CEOs across Europe, operating at the front lines of fast growth businesses and learning more in six months than most do in three years. If you thrive in a remote first environment and see your career as a mission, not just a job, you might be exactly who we’re looking for 🙌. Who is DonnaPro? We’re a European-based company of A-player Executive Assistants supporting Europe’s top CEOs and founders. From inboxes to project planning, we own what we do and help leaders go further, faster. Rated 4.8 out of 5 on Google , featured in major media outlets, and trusted by clients - 91% of them stay with us after the trial period. Our mission is to disrupt the industry and become one of the fastest-growing service companies in Europe. Excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement are in our DNA - and we only hire people who live by those standards. Who thrives at DonnaPro? A confident decision-maker with insane attention to detail Emotionally intelligent (you feel what's going on) Tech-savvy and resourceful  Takes radical ownership (you own your s#!t) No drama (you handle feedback like a pro and bounce forward) Career-driven and growth-hungry Hungry to be part of something bigger than "just a job" Based in any EU country What makes this role elite? You’ll work with Europe’s most driven entrepreneurs . These are high-level founders, investors, and CEOs who don’t need task-doers - they need partners. People who anticipate problems, manage moving pieces, and make things happen. If you’re looking to grow, evolve, and become irreplaceable - this is it. Your day-to-day impact: Admin Support : Manage inboxes, calendars, prep meetings, organize files Project Coordination: Assist with events, tasks, project tracking Research & Data: Dig up insights, write proposals, analyze information Personal Assistance: Organize travel, shop for gifts, plan special events You'll free up 60+ hours/month for your clients , so they can stay focused on building and scaling their business. What you’ll get: Starting Monthly Salary : You will earn €1600 per month after taxes and social contributions - no extra deductions or surprises. The stated amount is exactly what you’ll see in your bank account each month, and it’s 100% yours to keep. Performance bonuses for results that exceed expectations. Fast-track career growth into roles like Quality Manager, Team Lead, or even C-suite Mentorship & training from the best in the business Access to our DonnaPro Tribe - a private circle of ambitious, smart, remote-first professionals Complete infrastructure & support (you’ll never feel alone) Flexible work rhythm (CET core hours + trust-based flexibility) A badass team that gives a damn What you’ll need to succeed: 40h/week availability (160h/month) Fluent English (C2 level speaking & writing) EU-based Prior remote or office work experience Tools: G-Suite, Slack, Asana, WhatsApp, etc. You're already using AI tools like ChatGPT (and know how to make them work for you) High attention to detail + ability to move fast OK with both strategic and repetitive tasks Solid common sense, proactivity, and self-management Own a solid laptop/PC and stable internet Who this is not for: People who wait for instructions Anyone who dislikes feedback "Clock in, clock out" mentalities People who fear chaos, growth, pressure, or change We’re building a high-performing, no-BS, radically supportive environment. If you want to coast, this isn’t it. If you want to grow? Let’s go. Experience level: We often hire people with prior experience as EAs, PAs, or VAs. But if you’re new and can prove you’re an outlier, you should still apply - why not? Ready to rock? Here’s how to apply: #1 Complete the hiring form at the link below. Set aside about 30 minutes. Bring your A-game.  ➡️ https://donnapro.com/assistant-ceo-hire #2 Once you successfully complete the form—and if your vibe feels right—we’ll reach out to let you know the next steps in the hiring process. We’re aiming to get somebody soon, so try to move fast. If you have any issues, questions, or feedback please reach out to careers@donnapro.com.    That being said, wishing you the best of luck and looking forward to seeing you crushing it with the team soon. Good luck 👋, The DonnaPro Team

Proficiency in English at a near-native or native level; knowledge of French or Arabic is beneficial.

review_candidates.title: Demand Marketing Manager
review_candidates.description: Who are we? Meetingselect is the world's leading meetings & events booking platform that helps meeting planners at corporate enterprises across Europe, the USA and APAC search and book the right meetings and events venues. Our platform connects corporations, agencies and meeting planners with 500,000+ hotels and meeting venues in 150+ countries. We empower bookers and venues with smarter, data-driven meeting management, and we're doubling down on AI and innovation to get there faster. We're a young, diverse, and multicultural team with an informal culture. We want everyone to genuinely enjoy coming to work and feel free to be themselves. If you thrive in an environment where you're given real ownership, work closely with driven colleagues, and get to build and evolve how we do marketing, this might be your place. About the role Meetingselect is gearing up for a new phase of growth, and marketing is at the centre of it. We are making a meaningful shift in how we go to market: from reactive to proactive, from generic to differentiated positioning, and from ad hoc execution to a structured, AI-first marketing operation. That means building a function that captures existing demand and actively grows and educates new demand, enables sales through marketing signals, and runs in a more programmatic and scalable way. We are actively experimenting and setting up the foundation for this next phase, and there is real work to do and real ownership to take. To accelerate this journey, we have partnered with a highly regarded B2B SaaS marketing agency. Working alongside them gives you direct exposure to modern B2B marketing playbooks, sharp strategic thinking, and proven frameworks for demand generation and positioning that most in-house marketers only encounter years into their career. It is a genuine accelerator for anyone who wants to grow fast. As our Demand Marketing Manager , you sit at the heart of this transition. You report to the Marketing Team Lead and work in a small, close-knit team alongside a marketing intern and our agency partners. You're hands-on, self-directed, and comfortable driving things forward with a high degree of independence. This is a challenging role with real ownership. Prepare, execute and improve the planning cycle (budgeting, forecasting). Pro-actively advise local management team and business teams on finance related topics.
